name: vibe2value
description: Claude plugins from vibe2value. Build with AI and trust what you make.

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: Keep a running log of the decisions you make while building with AI, and the reason for each one. Zero setup: it records what you chose, what you chose it over and why, as it happens.

plugins.name: shape-build-launch
plugins.description: Guide building software with AI through the shape+build+launch framework: decide what to make (Shape), build it (Build), put it in front of people (Launch). Make each decision sharp before writing code, or run the framework backwards over a decision log of choices already made.
